metadata.description: Loomground packages (Apache-2.0): Versum knowledge-graph tools and analytic Solver decision methods. Governance policy authoring, authorization, enforcement, and audit ship separately under the RVND licence.

plugins.name: loomground-kg
plugins.description: A local-first, read-only cockpit and conversational query surface over the Loomground Versum knowledge graph. loomground-kg tracks the digest and routes work; loomground-kg-chat answers questions of the graph, grounded on every read.

plugins.name: loomground-versum
plugins.description: The Loomground Versum knowledge-graph plugin: the one write path into the graph, an organiser that places documents by shared mental models, the mental-model engine that scans content into a grounded ConceptGraph and projects it to any modality, and an enrichment loop that grows the graph from research findings. Deterministic floor, model on the rails, local-first; never auto-writes.

plugins.name: loomground-solver
plugins.description: Analytic and probabilistic reasoning over the Loomground Solver kernel: opponent modelling, probability tracking, strategic analysis, liability estimation, litigation-risk assessment, and risk analysis. Thin wrappers over the installed kernel.

plugins.name: solver-addons
plugins.description: Provider-neutral deterministic advice for deciding when optional Loomground Solver world-model and metacognition add-ons are useful. It reports scores, requirements, missing inputs, benefits and risks; it never retrieves data, selects providers, activates modules or authorizes actions.
